assertions.name: no_derived_volume_difference_closes_A3
assertions.source: Of the 2 of 3 observables that were actually EVALUATED, 0 close A≥3. (A) log|tr| volume: no derived ρ brings all four isotopes within a generous ±10% — the best is ~69% off on ⁴He; a generous window makes zero hits a stronger negative, not a weaker one. (B) cosh-inversion: 4/4 traces elliptic (|tr|<2), so no real length exists and the observable cannot close. (C) SnapPy: NOT EVALUATED — SnapPy is not installed, so this leg is absent from the count rather than counted as a refutation; see the caveat. Was computed=1/expected=1 (bean qou-26f2), which passed at the value that refutes the claim and hid C never having run.

description: Derive-or-refute: does B = ρ·[Vol(atom)−Vol(free)] close A≥3 binding, using DERIVED volumes (no census-knot fit)? Three observables all fail: (A) log|tr_M| volume — no derived ρ closes it (−55…−90%); (B) cosh-inversion — every |tr_M|<2 (elliptic), no real length; (C) SnapPy on the derived braid closure — non-hyperbolic (degenerate tetrahedra, Vol≈0). Hyperbolic volume needs complex-q (Kashaev N→∞), absent at the real substrate q₀; the only nonzero volumes come from hand-assigned census knots = a per-isotope fit. Converges with PR #1421 (no derived atom→knot rule).

conclusion.log_volume: refuted — no derived ρ closes (κ spans 313%)
conclusion.snappy_braid_closure: NOT EVALUATED — SnapPy not installed (was previously recorded as 'refuted', which it never was)
conclusion.interpretation: hyperbolic volume needs complex-q Kashaev N→∞, absent at real q₀; nonzero vols only via census-knot fit. Linear truncation not repaired by any real-q volume difference — missing structure is in the archimedean (complex-q) step.

caveats: Observable C (SnapPy hyperbolic volume of the derived braid closure) was NOT EVALUATED: SnapPy is not installed, and `_snappy_braid_vols` returns (None, None, False) on ImportError — indistinguishable at the call site from a genuine non-hyperbolic result. `vol_free` is null in the committed witness as well, so C has never been evaluated in this repo. The refutation recorded here therefore rests on observables A and B only; the 'triple refutation' in the description and the 'refuted — closures non-hyperbolic (Vol≈0)' conclusion overstate what ran (bean qou-26f2).
